The background shows a geometric tile pattern rendered with crosshatching and screen tones. The character is drawn in a realistic proportion style with detailed clothing folds and a composed, neutral expression. The overall composition places the character centrally within the frame, emphasizing his solitary presence against the architectural floor pattern.
